name: First Lesson of the Day
description: Open your personalized path and finish one lesson.
purpose_statement: Five focused minutes a day is the single most reliable predictor of long-term financial literacy.

name: Study Sprint
description: Complete two lessons back to back today.
purpose_statement: Stacking two lessons in one sitting helps you connect related money concepts before they fade.

name: Triple Lesson Day
description: Push through three lessons for a serious knowledge boost.
purpose_statement: A deep multi-lesson day builds durable mental links between budgeting, saving, and investing.

name: Skip a Treat, Save £3
description: Redirect £3 from a small daily luxury into your savings.
purpose_statement: Turning a minor everyday impulse into a deposit builds wealth without you ever feeling the pinch.

name: Fund Your Cushion
description: Add £5 to your savings today.
purpose_statement: Small, consistent deposits are how an emergency fund actually gets built.

name: Cover a Coffee Run
description: Set aside £8 before the day ends.
purpose_statement: Swapping one small habit for a deposit compounds into a real safety net over a month.

name: Stash a Tenner
description: Add £10 to your savings before midnight.
purpose_statement: Hitting a double-digit day trains your brain to treat saving as non-negotiable.

name: Big Save Day
description: Challenge yourself to save £20 in a single day.
purpose_statement: An occasional high-save day can cover a whole week of steady progress in one go.

name: Quick Recall
description: Answer 3 questions from your review queue.
purpose_statement: A tiny daily review stops the forgetting curve from wiping out your hard-earned progress.

name: Retention Rinse
description: Clear 5 items from your review queue today.
purpose_statement: Spaced repetition is what turns something you read once into intuition you can act on.

name: Memory Deep-Clean
description: Knock out 10 review items in one sitting.
purpose_statement: High-volume review sessions lock knowledge into long-term memory far better than tiny doses.

name: One Fact Wiser
description: Read today's featured finance fact.
purpose_statement: A fresh fact each day quietly rewires how you see spending, saving, and investing decisions.

name: Three-Lesson Week
description: Finish 3 lessons in your paths this week.
purpose_statement: A relaxed but steady weekly pace prevents burnout while your money knowledge compounds.

name: Five-Lesson Week
description: Power through 5 lessons across any active course.
purpose_statement: Immersing yourself in the material is how you conquer harder topics like investing or real estate.

name: Lesson Legend
description: Complete 7 lessons this week — one for every day.
purpose_statement: A lesson-a-day habit is the strongest signal that financial literacy is becoming part of who you are.

name: £50 Cushion
description: Save a total of £50 before the week ends.
purpose_statement: An achievable weekly target keeps you accountable and builds a predictable wealth trajectory.

name: The £100 Milestone
description: Save £100 this week.
purpose_statement: Hitting a real milestone proves you have the discipline serious wealth-building requires.

name: Serious Saver
description: Push your limits and save £200 over the week.
purpose_statement: Aggressive savings weeks give your future investments more capital to grow over time.

name: Weekly Retention Run
description: Clear 15 review items by the end of the week.
purpose_statement: Spreading retrieval practice across the week produces the deepest long-term retention.

name: Review Champion
description: Tackle 25 review items this week.
purpose_statement: Consolidating knowledge under volume is exactly the discipline financial mastery rewards.

name: Fact Seeker
description: Read 5 finance facts across the week.
purpose_statement: Broad financial knowledge helps you judge news, ads, and advice with healthy scepticism.

name: Conquer a Path
description: Complete one full learning path this week.
purpose_statement: Finishing a whole topic gives you a complete toolkit for that specific corner of your finances.
